name: The Story of a Survivor
source:
This game takes place in a post apocalyptic world. Mankind is almost completely extinct. Only a few survivors live on the Earth. This game is primarily about love and sex. Be a survivor. Build relationships and have a lot of sex with sexy surviving babes.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/piloo]Patreon[/url]]
